Ayçekirdeği (Çiğ ve Kavrulmuş + Tuzlu / Az Tuzlu / Tuzsuz)

Sunflower Seeds (Raw and Roasted + Salted / Lightly Salted / Unsalted)

Tufan Organik Sunflower Seeds (Raw and Roasted + Salted / Lightly Salted / Unsalted) belongs to the Nuts and Nut Products range. It is a natural food with roots in Gürün/Sivas; contact us for product, packaging and order details.

Sonnenblumenkerne (roh und geröstet + gesalzen / leicht gesalzen / ungesalzen)
